He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

people.name: Josiah
people.line: King of Judah known for his religious reforms

translations.web: The archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, “Take me away, because I am seriously wounded!”
translations.bsb: There the archers shot King Josiah, who said to his servants, “Take me away, for I am badly wounded!”
translations.kjv: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
translations.asv: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
